name: relay
description: Client Complaint Automation Platform (Flip the Switch hackathon)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @relay/shared -w @relay/db -w @relay/trackers -w @relay/llm -w @relay/core && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.build:server: npm run build -w @relay/shared -w @relay/db -w @relay/trackers -w @relay/llm -w @relay/core && npm run build -w @relay/channels -w @relay/switch -w @relay/api -w @relay/worker
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @relay/shared -w @relay/db -w @relay/trackers -w @relay/llm -w @relay/core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
